plan_summary: Execute a clean installation of Nginx on Ubuntu 24.04, including package acquisition, configuration baseline generation, and service validation.
assumptions: The target machine has internet access.

tasks.title: Verify system prerequisites
tasks.objective: Confirm the OS version and available disk space meet requirements for Nginx installation.
tasks.rationale: Ensuring compatibility before downloading packages prevents installation errors on unsupported distributions.
tasks.expected_output: Report confirming Ubuntu 24.04 and sufficient storage.
tasks.success_criteria: System is identified as Ubuntu 24.04 with at least 1GB free disk space.

tasks.title: Update package repositories
tasks.objective: Refresh the local package index to ensure access to the latest Nginx version and dependencies.
tasks.rationale: Updating before installation avoids installing outdated packages or hitting repository issues.
tasks.expected_output: Terminal output showing successful update of package lists.
tasks.success_criteria: Command returns exit code 0 with no unresolved dependencies.

tasks.title: Install Nginx packages
tasks.objective: Install the nginx main package and essential utilities like curl or net-tools if needed.
tasks.rationale: This step fetches the binary and configures the initial file structure from the repository.
tasks.expected_output: Nginx installed files present in /etc/nginx and binaries in /usr/sbin.
tasks.success_criteria: The 'nginx' binary exists and version string matches expected release.

tasks.title: Review default configuration files
tasks.objective: Examine /etc/nginx/nginx.conf and site-enabled sites for correct paths and settings.
tasks.rationale: Default configurations often need adjustments for production use, especially on fresh installs.
tasks.expected_output: List of existing configuration blocks and server names.
tasks.success_criteria: All syntax is valid and no critical errors are reported by the config test tool.

tasks.title: Test Nginx configuration syntax
tasks.objective: Run the built-in configuration checker to ensure no syntax errors exist before starting the service.
tasks.rationale: Starting a service with invalid config leads to immediate failure and security risks.
tasks.expected_output: Confirmation that configuration test passed without errors.
tasks.success_criteria: Command exits successfully indicating valid syntax.

tasks.title: Enable and start Nginx service
tasks.objective: Create a system startup entry and launch the Nginx daemon immediately.
tasks.rationale: Service must be active to handle incoming HTTP requests as soon as installation completes.
tasks.expected_output: Nginx process running on port 80 with systemd active status.
tasks.success_criteria: Systemd reports 'active (running)' and port 80 is listening.

tasks.title: Configure firewall rules
tasks.objective: Allow incoming TCP traffic on port 80 (HTTP) and optionally 443 (HTTPS).
tasks.rationale: Even with an active service, the firewall might block external clients from connecting.
tasks.success_criteria: External connectivity test confirms port access is granted.

tasks.title: Perform functional connectivity check
tasks.objective: Verify Nginx serves a default welcome page or custom content over HTTP.
tasks.rationale: Technical service status does not guarantee network accessibility; this confirms end-to-end operation.
tasks.expected_output: Successful HTTP response containing Nginx welcome message.
tasks.success_criteria: HTTP 200 returned with correct content-type header.

tasks.title: Generate installation report
tasks.objective: Document version, installed paths, and configuration summary for the user.
tasks.rationale: Documentation helps with future maintenance and troubleshooting of the newly installed system.
tasks.expected_output: Structured text or JSON report summarizing the installation.
tasks.success_criteria: Report contains version number and confirmation of successful setup.
